title: Lansing, MI — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Lansing, MI: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Lansing is a city in MI with a population of 112,000. Michigan’s capital with the State Capitol, Michigan State University nearby, and the Grand River. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.5.
